core_principles: Current warranted state outranks stale state
The field is part of the command
Peer input is not authority by default
Funding provenance is not a truth score
Claim strength may not outrun derivation
Absence of research is not negative evidence
AI assistance does not transfer accountability
Case finding and OGI finding are separate
Human participation is architectural, not auxiliary
Evidence state may not change without an operation
Oggy should self-intervene before a material unsupported transition
